_comment: 朝礼・夕礼ステージ（content/meetings/asakai_kantan.json）の しごとの 表の 絵のうち、**字を 入れる 5枚**。字を 入れない 5枚は asakai_tasks.json（noText が ちがう ので 台帳を 分けた。asakai_cards / asakai_zukai と 同じ 分けかた）。 2026-09-16 の 指定で 描き直し（字を 入れる）: 決済画面は Choeung Ek Genocidal Center の チケット予約／支払い方法は ABA・Credit・Cash／注文IDは ランダムで よく 金額は $6／決済APIの サーバは ABA／ACLEDA Pay を えらぶ 画面は ABA Pay・ACLEDA Pay・Cash の 3つ。 字は 英語（アプリは 外国から 来た 人が 使う）なので ふりがなは 要らない。**銀行の ロゴは 描かない**——名前を 字で 書くだけ。参照入力は 朝礼ページの エンジニア（顔）と、字の 無い 側の aba.webp（絵柄）。 Choeung Ek の 塔は ユーザーが 貼った 写真を 文で 写した（写真は ファイルに なって いなかった）。 台帳が 正で、教材JSONの src は その 写し（scripts/lib/image_ledger.mjs）。
style: Warm modern anime illustration, like a friendly Japanese educational manga — clean confident black linework, flat cel shading with gentle light, bright natural daylight, soft pastel palette of sky blue, cream and coral, rounded friendly shapes. A tidy contemporary Japanese software office with real desks, chairs, windows, plants, mugs and laptops. People are drawn as real human beings with natural proportions, warm friendly faces and exactly five fingers on each hand. Every picture is a REAL PLACE seen from a natural camera angle, and the subject FILLS THE WHOLE FRAME. This is a TEACHING picture, not a mood picture: what the person is doing must be readable from the picture alone. The picture will be shown very small, about 80 pixels wide, so keep it to ONE person and ONE screen, drawn LARGE and simple, with the screen's contents big and bold and a clear dominant colour; leave small details out.
noText: Lettering — read this part carefully. The picture contains ONLY the words and numbers written inside double quotation marks in the scene above, and no other writing at all. Print each of them LARGE and horizontally in a clean rounded sans-serif font with generous space around it, spelled EXACTLY as given, letter for letter and digit for digit, so that it stays sharp and easy to read at a glance. Every other part of every screen, card and button is blank or shows only plain grey rounded bars. Payment and bank names are written as plain text only — never draw a bank logo or brand mark. No other letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or speech balloons anywhere in the picture.
negative: Never: photo-realistic rendering, harsh shadows, extra or merged fingers, distorted hands, dark or scary mood, angry or crying faces, watermarks, real company logos or brand marks of any kind, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, tiny cluttered text, paragraphs of text, 3D render, flat vector icon art, pictograms floating on an empty background, robots, mascots, a second person, a wide empty room shot where the person and the screen are small. Never: misspelled words, extra words, Japanese writing, a bank logo.

scenes.title: 1 決済の 画面
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: she is BUILDING the ticket-booking payment screen for a visit to the Choeung Ek Genocidal Center. Close view of the new engineer — a young Cambodian woman in her early twenties with warm light-brown skin, a round friendly face and black hair tied back in a low ponytail, wearing a mint-green blouse, beige trousers and a lanyard with a blank white card, sitting at her desk with both hands on the keyboard and looking up at a large monitor that FILLS most of the frame. On the monitor stands one big upright phone mockup showing the booking page she is building: at the top a wide rounded photo of the Choeung Ek memorial stupa — a tall, slender, white memorial tower standing on a low white base in the middle of a wide green lawn, topped by a tiered Khmer-style roof with golden-yellow gables edged in grey and a tall pointed spire, with leafy green trees on both sides and a bright blue sky with a few white clouds. Under the photo is one line of large text reading "Choeung Ek", and at the bottom one wide rounded SKY-BLUE button reading "Book Ticket". Calm, focused, respectful expression.
